title: [Chapitre] IV. Analysis situs (première mouture) : notes manuscrites (10/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from pp. 40-43 of the 1986 'Analysis situs' notes): Grothendieck is building an axiomatic, combinatorial theory of tame or stratified spaces. The ingredients are:
- a 'multistructure' M, a set of cells ordered by a face relation ≤ and by a refinement relation ≪;
- 'figures' F, finite subsets of M closed under passing to faces;
- 'lieux' (places, i.e. generalized points);
- the 'ombre' (shadow) X̃ of a cell, meaning the set of places it carries;
- the 'open stratum' X̃° of a cell, meaning the places of X̃ that lie in no strictly smaller face.
Page 41 characterized when a refinement F' ≪ F is a subdivision. Cond 7 / Cor 1 there say that open strata of distinct cells are disjoint.

On this page (after two abandoned starts of a 'Cor. 2' about places in open strata of distinct strata being disjoint), he wants the analogue of the classical carrier map of a subdivision. Given a figure F and a subdivision or refinement F', define a map F' → F sending each cell X' of F' to the unique cell X of F with X̃'° ⊂ X̃°. Equivalently, X is the smallest X ∈ F with X̃'° ⊂ X̃. Uniqueness would follow from disjointness of open strata (Cond 7).

He notes that existence amounts to saying that the partition of the shadow into open strata induced by F' is finer than the one induced by F. His attempt runs as follows:
1. Take X ∈ F minimal with X' ≪ X; it exists by the finiteness axiom.
2. We know X̃' ⊂ X̃.
3. So a place x ∈ X̃'° lies in Ỹ° for some face Y ≤ X.
4. One must show Y = X.
He stops: 'Il semblerait qu'il manque quelque chose', i.e. an axiom is missing.

The next page supplies it as Cons 8, a restriction or intersection axiom. If Y ≪ X and X' < X, the cells of F_Y refining X' form a subfigure R_{X'}, which is the infimum of F_Y and F_{X'} for ≪, and Ỹ ∩ X̃' = ∪_{Y'∈R_{X'}} Ỹ'. From it he deduces: if no X_1 satisfies Y ≪ X_1 < X, then Ỹ° ⊂ X̃°.

That is exactly what closes the gap here. If the face Y containing x were a proper face of X, then x ∈ X̃' ∩ Ỹ would lie in Z̃ for some Z ≤ X' with Z ≪ Y. Since x is in the open stratum of X', this forces Z = X', so X' ≪ Y < X, contradicting the minimality of X. Hence the carrier map is well defined.
errors: The argument as written on the page is incomplete. Minimality of X with X' ≪ X does not by itself give X̃'° ⊂ X̃° without an axiom relating Ỹ ∩ X̃' to cells refining both. Grothendieck flags this himself, and supplies the axiom (Cons 8) on the next page.
Uniqueness of the image cell also rests on Cond 7 (disjointness of open strata of distinct cells), which is only an added axiom on p. 41, not a derived fact.
Minor slip: 'x' ∈ F'' should read 'X' ∈ F''. Cells, not places, are being mapped.

ideas.what: Carrier map of a subdivision: send each cell of the subdivision to the unique cell of the original complex whose open cell contains it (equivalently, the smallest closed cell containing it)
ideas.modern_name: carrier map / support map of a subdivision (PL topology); refinement of stratifications
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical combinatorial topology (Alexander, Newman, Whitehead; standard in PL topology texts)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5-6 only sketches 'topologie modérée' programmatically; this axiomatics is unpublished

ideas.what: Recognizing that the open-strata partition of F' must refine that of F, and that a restriction/intersection axiom (infimum of refinements, Ỹ ∩ X̃' as a union of shadows) is needed to prove it
ideas.modern_name: axioms of a refining stratification / meet of refinements in a face poset; analogous to o-minimal cell decomposition compatibility
ideas.usually_credited_to: o-minimal cell decomposition (van den Dries, Knight-Pillay-Steinhorn) for the geometric analogue

missed.claim: The page shows the axiomatic 'multistructure' framework needing an extra axiom (Cons 8, intersection/restriction of refinements) to obtain the carrier map. It is a working step in an unpublished axiomatization of tame topology, not a new result in itself.
missed.quote: Il semblerait qu'il manque quelque chose.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It documents which axioms Grothendieck found necessary for a purely combinatorial 'analysis situs' of stratified objects. This may interest anyone formalizing tame topology or face-poset/locale approaches, but the mathematics is standard.

deep.surprise_reason: The content is the classical carrier map of a subdivision, worked out within Grothendieck's own unpublished axiomatics. It is of historical interest as part of the 1986 Analysis situs project but holds no new result.
transcription_corrections: '∀ x' ∈ F'' should be '∀ X' ∈ F''; likewise '{l'unique} x ∈ F' should be 'X ∈ F'.
'Ça suppose déjà prouvé tel X existe' probably reads 'Ça suppose déjà prouvé qu'un tel X existe'.

'la relation d'égalité [?] coïncide sur l'ensemble de F'' likely reads 'la relation d'équivalence induite sur l'ombre de F'', and 'celle induite par l'ensemble de F' likely reads 'celle induite par l'ombre de F'. Throughout, 'l'ensemble' is probably 'l'ombre'.
'avons-nous pour cela [?]' likely reads 'avons-nous pour autant'.
'(ou encore le plus petit X ∈ F tel que X̃'° ⊂ X̃)': the inclusion is into the closed shadow X̃, consistent with the image.
'pour Y ≤ X' is likely 'pour un Y ≤ X'.
